name: U-Pick Blueberries
description: U-Pick Blueberries grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Blackberries, Apricots, and Plums in Santa Maria, CA. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through spring and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
